summary.en: Syrian internal security forces arrested former regime officer Ahmad Raslan and a former general accused of the 2014 Ghouta ambush. Two young men were killed by a landmine explosion and another young man died in a war-remnant blast while herding livestock in the Aleppo countryside. Syrian Airlines announced direct flights from Damascus and Aleppo to Cairo. Over 23,000 children have been killed during the civil war, and there were 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske interne sikkerhetsstyrker arresterte den tidligere regimoffiseren Ahmad Raslan og en tidligere general som er anklaget for ambushen i Ghouta i 2014. To unge menn ble drept av en landmineeksplosjon, og en annen ung mann døde i en eksplosjon fra krigsrester mens han gjette dyr på landsbygda utenfor Aleppo. Syrian Airlines kunngjorde direktefly fra Damaskus og Aleppo til Kairo. Over 23 000 barn har blitt drept under borgerkrigen, og det var 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
